text: I had a long day. Could I tell you something without making it a big deal?

options.label: I'm here. Take your time.
options.say: I'm here. Take all the time you need.

then.text: I think I like you as more than a map-reading friend.

options.label: We can take this one step at a time.
options.say: We can take this one step at a time.

then.text: Thank you. I like you, and I don't want to rush what is growing.
Your answer made it easier to say what I feel.
We have time. I'm glad we can be honest about the pace.
I trust this feeling enough to ask: will you meet me at the garden?

otherwise.text: No need to answer now. The garden will still be there when we're ready.
